behaviors.source: GH #301 AC1 ("An audit invocation failure classifies under the existing agent-failure-cause taxonomy"), ADR 0025 lines 40-46
behaviors.given: rejections carrying a TransientProviderError, a tool-call-cap kill message, a wall-clock-ceiling kill message, an idle-kill message, an "exited with code 1" message, and a plain Error
behaviors.when: the pure classifySelfAuditFailure exported from src/self-audit.ts classifies each one
behaviors.then: the kinds are transient-exhausted, orchestrator-kill with killClass tool-call-cap, orchestrator-kill with killClass wall-clock-ceiling, orchestrator-kill with killClass idle-timeout, provider-exit with exitCode 1, and internal-error, each carrying a non-blank summary
behaviors.observableResult: a [behavior:B-01] unit test in src/self-audit.test.ts asserts the kind, killClass and exitCode of each of the six classified causes and that every summary is non-blank, and src/self-audit.ts imports isTransientProviderError from ./agent-provider.js and nothing from ./orchestrator.js

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC2 ("Only infrastructure-classified causes retry the audit invocation"), src/orchestrator.ts:1841-1848
behaviors.given: each cause kind classifySelfAuditFailure can produce
behaviors.when: the pure isInfrastructureSelfAuditCause exported from src/self-audit.ts is called with it
behaviors.then: provider-exit, non-cap orchestrator-kill and transient-exhausted are true, and a tool-call-cap orchestrator-kill and internal-error are false
behaviors.observableResult: a [behavior:B-02] unit test in src/self-audit.test.ts asserts true for the three infrastructure kinds and false for the tool-call-cap kill and internal-error, and a [behavior:B-02] case shows a tool-call-cap rejection is dispatched at most once even with infrastructureRetries set

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC2 (an infrastructure-classified dead invocation is re-dispatched under the run's --infrastructure-retries budget); docs/adr/0025-agent-failure-causes.md:55-60; src/self-audit.ts:147, :171-219, :186; src/orchestrator.ts:5312-5322, :6288-6289, :6433; docs/adr/0069-bounded-generator-self-audit-before-qa-dispatch.md:73-77
behaviors.given: runSelfAuditStage with an injected dispatch spy and a log sink spy, driven with (a) a stage input with infrastructureRetries: 2 whose dispatch rejects with "Agent generator exited with code 1" twice and then completes leaving the tree unchanged, (b) inputs with infrastructureRetries: 2 whose dispatch rejects with a tool-call-cap kill or whose envelope assembly throws, and (c) degenerate-budget inputs: one omitting infrastructureRetries entirely and ones carrying -1, 1.5 and Number.NaN, each with a dispatch that always rejects with "exited with code 1"
behaviors.when: runSelfAuditStage is awaited on each input
behaviors.then: attempts are infrastructureRetries + 1 and the loop stops on the first completed invocation, so case (a) dispatches three times and returns AUDIT_UNCHANGED with exactly one run-state entry; a non-infrastructure cause dispatches once and never retries, so each case (b) input dispatches exactly once; and every degenerate budget in case (c) reads as 0 rather than throwing — absent, negative, fractional, NaN, Infinity or a non-number all dispatch exactly once and land AUDIT_NOT_RUN through B-04 rather than rejecting, because this stage may never block a run by its own input validation; each retry narrates through the existing log sink as "self-audit: infrastructure retry N/M — <cause summary>"; and the hub passes infrastructureRetries: config.infrastructureRetries ?? DEFAULT_INFRASTRUCTURE_RETRIES at its one call site so src/self-audit.ts never imports the hub's constant
behaviors.observableResult: src/self-audit.test.ts's [behavior:B-03] tests assert the dispatch spy call counts (3 for case (a); 1 for each case (b) input; exactly 1 for each of the four case (c) inputs) and that no case (c) or (b) call rejects, with each case (c) result being { ran: true, verdict: "AUDIT_NOT_RUN", treeId: <released tree id> }; they assert the two "self-audit: infrastructure retry" log lines naming 1/2 and 2/2 in case (a) and no such line in cases (b) and (c); and a [behavior:B-03] source scan of src/orchestrator.ts asserts the runSelfAuditStage({ … }); call passes infrastructureRetries: config.infrastructureRetries ?? DEFAULT_INFRASTRUCTURE_RETRIES. An implementation that throws on -1 or NaN, or that treats undefined as unbounded retry, fails the case (c) assertions

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC3 ("Audit retry exhaustion records AUDIT_NOT_RUN in run state")

behaviors.then: recordSelfAuditOutcome has appended exactly one entry with verdict AUDIT_NOT_RUN, candidateTreeId the released tree id, the stage input's runId, and no auditedTreeId key
behaviors.observableResult: [behavior:B-04] unit tests in src/self-audit.test.ts read selfAuditsFor(loadRunState(...), ghIssue) and assert one entry whose verdict is "AUDIT_NOT_RUN", whose candidateTreeId is the released id, whose runId equals the input runId, and for which "auditedTreeId" in entry is false; the exhausted case also asserts exactly two dispatch calls

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC4 ("After AUDIT_NOT_RUN, the candidate proceeds to QA dispatch"), ADR 0041

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC5 (the audit outcome entry in run state carries run-ID provenance); src/run-state.ts:49-66, :71, :258, :368-374, :1028-1035, :1036-1082; src/stop-sentinel.ts:106; src/orchestrator.ts:5973; src/eval-boundary.test.ts:127
behaviors.given: the run-state module, a v8 run-state file whose selfAudits entry carries a nonblank runId, and separately v7-shaped files whose entry omits runId or carries a blank one
behaviors.when: RUN_STATE_VERSION, the version union and PersistedSelfAuditOutcome are read and each file is loaded
behaviors.then: PersistedSelfAuditOutcome carries a required runId: string, RUN_STATE_VERSION is 8 and the version union is 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 with the version-history comment extended in its existing style; the bump is unconditional because otherwise a v7 file whose entries predate provenance is indistinguishable from one whose entries carry it; the v8 entry loads with its runId intact; and an entry without a usable runId yields no selfAudits member for that issue — the sanitizer's existing whole-issue-list granularity, not a new rule: the runId check joins the malformed-entry condition at src/run-state.ts:1062-1069, which sets dropped = true and breaks, after which if (dropped || entries.length === 0) continue; (src/run-state.ts:1078) drops that ghIssue key, exactly as the helper's doc comment states (src/run-state.ts:1031-1035, "A malformed entry degrades the whole issue's list to absent rather than only itself"). No discard granularity changes for the pre-existing candidateTreeId, verdict or auditedTreeId checks. SelfAuditStageInput gains a required runId: string bound at the hub's one call site to runIdFor(logger.runDir), so the stage never derives run identity itself
behaviors.observableResult: src/run-state.test.ts's [behavior:B-06] tests assert RUN_STATE_VERSION === 8, that a v8 fixture round-trips its entry's runId, and that each runId-less or blank-runId fixture loads with selfAuditsFor(state, ghIssue) empty and state.selfAudits having no key for that issue while every other member is intact — the same whole-list outcome the existing blank-candidateTreeId case already produces, asserted alongside it so a per-entry rewrite of the sanitizer fails; pnpm run typecheck refuses a PersistedSelfAuditOutcome or SelfAuditStageInput literal without runId; and a [behavior:B-06] source scan of src/orchestrator.ts asserts the runSelfAuditStage({ … }); call passes runId: runIdFor(logger.runDir)

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC6 ("A resumed run treats a persisted audit outcome as spent"), PRD story 8
behaviors.given: run-state files holding, in turn, an AUDIT_UNCHANGED entry whose two tree ids are the released id, an AUDIT_CHANGED entry whose auditedTreeId is the released id and whose candidateTreeId is not, an AUDIT_NOT_RUN entry naming the released id, and an entry naming a different tree in both fields
behaviors.when: runSelfAuditStage is awaited on the released tree
behaviors.then: the first three return { ran: false, spent: <that entry's verdict> } with zero dispatches and no second entry, and the fourth dispatches once and appends a second entry
behaviors.observableResult: [behavior:B-07] unit tests in src/self-audit.test.ts assert the returned spent verdict, a dispatch spy count of 0, and selfAuditsFor length still 1 for each of the three spent cases, and a dispatch count of 1 with length 2 for the non-matching case

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC7 and AC8 ("The run summary reports the changed-rate")
behaviors.given: an event stream with three AUDIT_UNCHANGED, one AUDIT_CHANGED and two AUDIT_NOT_RUN events; a stream with only AUDIT_NOT_RUN events; and a run directory with no events.jsonl
behaviors.when: deriveSelfAuditOutcomes and the exported readSelfAuditOutcomes run over them
behaviors.then: the first yields { unchanged: 3, changed: 1, notRun: 2, graded: 4, changedRatePercent: 25 }, the second yields graded 0 with changedRatePercent absent, and the third yields zero totals without throwing
behaviors.observableResult: [behavior:B-09] unit tests in src/logger.test.ts assert the three derived totals objects, that AUDIT_NOT_RUN is excluded from the rate denominator, and that readSelfAuditOutcomes on an empty run directory returns zero totals rather than throwing

behaviors.source: GH #301 AC2 and PRD Implementation Decisions (prd.md:95-97: only infrastructure causes retry and exhaustion lands AUDIT_NOT_RUN); docs/adr/0069-bounded-generator-self-audit-before-qa-dispatch.md:52-53, :69-72
